interface.longDescription: Hypes gives the assistant a private, revisable relationship model of the user. It uses the relevant relationships only when they materially change an interpretation or choice. The user's current message always takes priority, and Hypes does not store raw conversations, direct identifiers, sensitive traits, Sense guidance, or Corpus source-linked context.
